# sbx-browser

> Self-hosted orchestration for cloud coding agents: run official provider CLIs (Codex, Devin, Antigravity, Grok, OpenCode) in isolated Modal Sandboxes behind one REST API.

Self-hosted under your own Modal workspace and your own provider subscriptions; not a hosted service.

## Getting started

- [Introduction](/getting-started/introduction/): what sbx-browser is and when to use it
- [Quick start](/getting-started/quick-start/): clone, init, deploy, first agent in ~10 minutes

## Guides

- [Console](/guides/console/): web console for tasks, agents, and review
- [Agents and runs](/guides/agents-and-runs/): lifecycle, follow-up turns, cancel/close
- [Streaming](/guides/streaming/): SSE events, Last-Event-ID resume
- [Repositories](/guides/repositories/): workspace contract, git delivery, PRs
- [Workflows](/guides/workflows/): gated pipelines and recovery
- [Accounts](/guides/accounts/): provider accounts, slots, failover

## Concepts

- [Concepts](/concepts/): agent, run, provider, account, workflow, artifact
